Market today: Cautious optimism for tech/chips. Fed comments on steady rates are a tailwind, but Broadcom's forecast and general chip volatility remain key drivers.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.34%) and SPAL (-33.6%) are major concerns due to leveraged decay and significant losses, especially on margin. SMH (-14.47%) and QQQI (-3.76%) are also on 'TRIM' status.

Watch: Monitor the broader chip sector's reaction to Broadcom's forecast and any further Fed commentary on rates.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on leveraged positions; margin amplifies every move.
plays: SOXL is a 'SELL' at -60.34%. Leveraged ETFs decay; consider reducing exposure to manage risk.
SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is down -33.6%. Review its stop at 21.38 to protect capital on this volatile position.
Consider NVDA: Scanner shows 'ACCUMULATE' (entry 225.35-225.12, stop 223.39), supported by recent M&A news.
